# Changelog and historical decisions (history)

> Parent: [MEMORY.md](MEMORY.md) · When to read this category: you want to know how a constraint or value came about

| Topic | One-liner | When to read |
|---|---|---|
| [changelog/bootstrap](changelog/bootstrap.md) | How the repository scaffolding and the seven scope decisions were settled (2026-09-17) | You want to know why it was set up this way originally and what was found at the time |
| [changelog/caption-defect-fix](changelog/caption-defect-fix.md) | Fixed the stray backslashes in 6 captions - and how that overturned the "comma escaping" design | You want to know why the fingerprint baseline was re-sampled and why a case was rewritten |
| [changelog/ui-picker-and-zoom](changelog/ui-picker-and-zoom.md) | 2026-09-18, three WebUI experience changes: the graphical directory picker (§4.12), tag diff coloring, double-click zoom preview | You want to know how "what about non-loopback" and "why the zoom preview reuses the editor" were decided |
| [changelog/picker-manual-input-and-mkdir](changelog/picker-manual-input-and-mkdir.md) | 2026-09-19, the directory picker gained manual input and "create directory" (§4.12 adds `POST /api/fs/pick/mkdir`, loopback gate widened to six) | You want to know "why create-directory is a write endpoint", "why only a single path component is allowed", "why not window.prompt" |
| [changelog/read-only-guard-vs-live-dataset](changelog/read-only-guard-vs-live-dataset.md) | 2026-09-19, the read-only fingerprint criterion changed from "compare against the 2026-09 snapshot" to "compare against before the run": the expiring dataset-snapshot assertion was dropped from the automatic gate (A1 relativized, A19b switched to a synthetic round trip) | You want to know "why the dataset fingerprint no longer compares against the baseline", "why those three cases are red", "whether a test may assert the contents of real data" |
| [changelog/dir-list-layout](changelog/dir-list-layout.md) | 2026-09-18, left-column directory browsing layout: the count no longer wraps, the list scrolls independently, the header and hint stay fixed; and static assets got no-cache (a refresh after a change no longer serves stale CSS) | You want to know "why 'n images' wrapped", "why the root list was almost squeezed to a sliver", "why the frontend refresh showed no change" |
| [changelog/resizable-panels](changelog/resizable-panels.md) | 2026-09-18, draggable sidebar width: .layout switched to flex, two separators, localStorage memory, keyboard accessible | You want to know why the sidebar width moved from grid to a CSS variable and how clamping is computed |
| [changelog/ui-folder-grid-preview](changelog/ui-folder-grid-preview.md) | 2026-09-18, the center gallery's folder grid preview (§4.13): appears only on a level with "folders only", sampling comes from /api/fs/list, no server-side montage | You want to know why the root directory gets folder cards, where the grid data comes from, why there's no server-side montage |
| [changelog/zoom-nav-arrows](changelog/zoom-nav-arrows.md) | 2026-09-18, the zoom preview's previous/next moved from title-bar buttons to gallery-style navigation arrows on either side of the image | You want to know why the paging controls moved onto the image and why they're hidden entirely for a single image |
| [changelog/zoom-image-viewer](changelog/zoom-image-viewer.md) | 2026-09-18, the zoom preview image supports wheel zoom and drag panning (an image viewer control): cursor-anchored zoom, pointer-grab panning, reset on image change | You want to know why zoom uses transform instead of changing the layout, why the wheel needs passive:false, why paging resets |
| [changelog/tag-editing-and-filtering](changelog/tag-editing-and-filtering.md) | 2026-09-18, batch tag editing and filtering added after studying dataset-tag-editor: batch gained `edit_tags`/`prepend`/`regex_replace_text` and `dry_run` previews, a frontend batch panel, and a frequency table with search/sort/selection set/visible-image counts | You want to know "why batch editing isn't stage-then-backup", "why common tags are a row list, not a text box", "why search runs before truncation" |
| [changelog/pip-index-profiles](changelog/pip-index-profiles.md) | 2026-09-19, the environment scripts split into a regular profile and a China profile (`setup_env_cn.*`): why fallback is sequential, why TUNA isn't in the profile, ps1 gained `-DryRun` | You want to know "why the China mirror isn't one fixed source", "why pip needs an explicit --index-url", "where -DryRun came from" |
| [changelog/nav-scroll-memory](changelog/nav-scroll-memory.md) | 2026-09-19, scroll memory for directory navigation (§4.15): after a list is rebuilt wholesale it either stops on "the folder that just appeared" or at the position it was last left; four components share `navscroll.js` and don't use `scrollIntoView` | You want to know "why going back up still snaps to the top", "reveal vs memory, who wins", "why the root list gets no reveal" |
| [changelog/gallery-loading-and-live-regions](changelog/gallery-loading-and-live-regions.md) | 2026-09-19, the gallery thumbnail loading state, the frontend first live regions, and empty states that name the next step | You want to know why a loading tile no longer looks like a transparent PNG, where the first aria-live regions are, or why seven empty states grew a next step |
| [changelog/caption-write-safety](changelog/caption-write-safety.md) | 2026-09-19, a failed caption write no longer loses the typing: `flush()` reports failure, `activateImage` refuses to navigate, the error stays on screen, and leaving raw mode asks before truncating | You want to know why the editor can refuse to switch images, why `flush()` has three answers, or why the save-failure message no longer flashes for one frame |
| [changelog/long-job-visibility](changelog/long-job-visibility.md) | 2026-09-19, long operations say they are running: the cache rebuild is single-flight, a batch write locks the panel and keeps its outcome table, and the scale cancel reads the answer and arms a watchdog | You want to know why the cache panel locks itself, why a batch write keeps its diff table, or why a refused cancel no longer freezes the export panel |
| [changelog/keyboard-and-dialogs](changelog/keyboard-and-dialogs.md) | 2026-09-19, the filter table became keyboard operable, chips and tabs got real accessible names and state, and the directory picker took ownership of the keyboard while it is open | You want to know why frequency rows are buttons, why a chip remove button says which tag it clears, how the tablist is wired, or why the picker ignores keys from outside itself |
| [changelog/failure-states](changelog/failure-states.md) | 2026-09-19, failures stop looking like success: a failed load clears the previous directory subject, errors are sticky with retry and dismiss, and the connection pill re-checks itself | You want to know why the cache or frequency panel empties itself on an error, why error toasts no longer disappear, or where app.retry/app.dismiss are used |
| [changelog/batch-jobs](changelog/batch-jobs.md) | 2026-09-19, the batch caption write and the cache rebuild gained a job form (job id + SSE + cancel that stops between images), additive next to the synchronous endpoints | You want to know why `/captions/batch/run` exists, what a cancel does and does not undo, or why the job form refuses `dry_run` |
| [changelog/batch-backup-parity](changelog/batch-backup-parity.md) | 2026-09-19, the batch caption rewrite backs the caption up before overwriting it (`backup`, default true) - the tagger's net, wired through the shared `_batch_step`; fail-closed, invisible to scans and the cache | You want to know why the batch panel grew a 写入前备份 checkbox, what happens when the backup cannot be written, or how A40 scores it |
| [changelog/ui-copy-audit](changelog/ui-copy-audit.md) | 2026-09-19, all 474 strings x 3 packs audited twice (the writing rules + how a person reads a sentence): messages that named the wrong event, controls named that do not exist, five assembled-sentence sites, the dialog title; four new criteria and the "reading logic" rules | You want to know why a string was reworded, which rules now have a test, or how the en/ja audits were verified |
| [changelog/batch-performance](changelog/batch-performance.md) | 2026-09-19, batch operations measured first and optimized by benefit: the export render stage is parallel (5.0x), the caption probe is one batched request per chunk, and the write/cache paths were deliberately left alone as already seconds | You want to know why export is parallel, why the batch write and cache rebuild were judged not worth it, or what the baseline numbers were |
| [changelog/tagger-gpu-provider](changelog/tagger-gpu-provider.md) | 2026-09-19, the WD14 tagger's default provider list omitted DirectML, so on the DirectML install the setup scripts produce it silently ran on CPU (0.75 s/image instead of 0.20); the default is now CUDA -> DirectML -> CPU | You want to know why the tagger was slow on a machine where check_provider said DirectML was fine, or how the default provider order is decided |
| [changelog/confirm-dialog-and-focus](changelog/confirm-dialog-and-focus.md) | 2026-09-19, an in-app confirmation dialog replaced window.confirm everywhere (naming the action, defaulting to no), root and model-directory removal finally ask, every dialog hands focus back, and images are named once | You want to know why window.confirm disappeared, why removing a root asks now, where focus goes when a dialog closes, or why a tile image has an empty alt |
| [changelog/ui-defect-batch-a](changelog/ui-defect-batch-a.md) | 2026-09-19, the panel defect batch that changed no contract: the tagger's diff never went stale on a scope change, a preview that found nothing re-armed Run, an over-cap scope left Preview clickable, a cancel could not be retried, and a failed model list or a lost cache stream looked like empty success - plus the one audit finding that was withdrawn and reverted after the preview's semantics were questioned | You want to know why the tagger's Run/Preview gating is where it is, why the write mode is deliberately not in the preview signature, or how two audit reports were verified before anything was changed |
| [changelog/scale-toml-safety](changelog/scale-toml-safety.md) | 2026-09-19, the export stops replacing an existing dataset.toml on its own: `overwrite_dataset_toml` (default false) is the way through, that path backs the previous file up first, and `backup_file` is now the one implementation of the byte-level backup shared with the caption writes | You want to know why an export can report "dataset.toml: left alone" instead of a path, why the scale panel grew a second checkbox but still no confirmation dialog, or where the .bak convention comes from |
| [changelog/caption-restore](changelog/caption-restore.md) | 2026-09-19, a caption write can be taken back: `restore_caption` puts the .bak back byte for byte and consumes it, `POST /captions/restore` exposes it, the batch panel drops its dialog when the backup is on (the toast carries 撤销), and the cancelled-write copy stopped claiming it cannot be undone | You want to know why the batch write no longer asks before writing, where the undo lives, why the backup is deleted after a restore, or which criterion the behavioral harness caught a real bug in |
| [changelog/shared-scope-control](changelog/shared-scope-control.md) | 2026-09-19, the two panels that write captions answer "which images?" with one shared control (web/js/scope.js): four scopes with live counts, the same providers from app.js, the batch panel's default kept, and its scope finally visible on the panel that obeys it | You want to know why the batch panel grew a scope selector, why the batch default is still the filter result, why the recursive scope shows "…" instead of 0, or why the tagger's scope code moved |
| [changelog/job-shelf](changelog/job-shelf.md) | 2026-09-19, one shelf for every long job (web/js/jobs.js): panels register the jobs they already own, so a running job is visible and cancellable from every tab, two jobs are two rows, and the batch cancel gained the watchdog it was missing | You want to know why a progress bar is on screen while you are on another tab, why the shelf added no new copy, what happens to the row when a stream is lost, or why the batch panel grew a cancel timeout |
| [changelog/job-resume](changelog/job-resume.md) | 2026-09-19, a running job survives a page reload (web/js/jobstore.js): panels bookmark their job id in sessionStorage and pick it back up at boot, because every job stream replays its complete event log - and the reload revealed that the tagger panel could not be constructed at all (a missing import no gate caught) | You want to know why a refresh no longer loses a running job, why the bookmark is sessionStorage and not localStorage, or how the tagger-panel construction and import criteria came about |
| [missing-caption-mode](changelog/missing-caption-mode.md) | The gallery's "select images missing a caption" became a **mode** (tag filtering and the caption-less set are disjoint domains), and a caption-less image stopped passing an `exclude`-only filter. | Changing the gallery toolbar, the filter conditions, or what the batch panels act on |
| [changelog/image-cropping](changelog/image-cropping.md) | 2026-09-20, the crop tool: a rectangle confirmed per image and archived beside the source as `<stem>_N` (always numbered, never overwriting, source untouched), display coordinates so EXIF-rotated photos crop the way they are shown, no caption inherited, and the box carried to the next image as the same relative window | You want to know why the archive is always numbered instead of taking the bare name, why no caption is inherited, what a different-resolution next image does with the box, or why the export step is deliberately absent from this pipeline |
| [changelog/caption-dock](changelog/caption-dock.md) | The caption editor of the active image stopped being a tab and became a pinned dock below the tab panels (one live instance, a short empty state when nothing is active, a remembered fold), so walking the grid and fixing captions needs neither a tab switch nor the modal zoom view | Changing the right column's layout or its tab strip, the editor's empty state, or anything that decides which panel is on screen |
| [dataset-change-polling](changelog/dataset-change-polling.md) | The gallery polls `/api/fs/list` (image count + newest mtime) so a dataset edited by the trainer or by hand shows up without a manual refresh - skipped while a job runs, in a background tab, or while a field has focus. | Touching the gallery reload path, the boot timers, or anything that assumes `state.images` only changes on navigation |
| [gallery-filter-strip](changelog/gallery-filter-strip.md) | The filter's conditions moved to where their effect is: the chips and the count left the Filter tab for a `#gallery-filter` strip above the grid, missing mode and "show selected images only" became removable chips of the same strip, and the count line stopped naming the mode in prose. | Changing the gallery toolbar or the center panel, the chips/count, or anything that decides what the grid shows and why |
| [shared-scope-strip](changelog/shared-scope-strip.md) | The processing scope became one control for the whole right column: a `#scope-strip` outside the scrolling tab panels, built once in app.js and subscribed to by both caption-writing panels (one live value instead of one per panel), the shared default is now the selection, and the export panel states the coverage its frozen `root` request cannot let it choose. | Changing the right column's layout, `scope.js`, either panel that writes captions, or the export panel's coverage copy |
| [readiness-toml-status](changelog/readiness-toml-status.md) | The readiness strip's third segment stops shrugging: §4.16 adds one read-only `stat` of `<dataset root>/dataset.toml` (existence + mtime + size, never contents, never a write), the segment's file claim is gated on that fact while the export panel's report may only make it worse, and the fact is re-asked on navigation, on the 15 s poll, after a finished export and on a click | Changing the readiness strip's third segment, the dataset root's `dataset.toml` status endpoint, the export panel's report, or anything that decides what the app knows about the trainer's file |
| [readiness-strip-and-layout-probe](changelog/readiness-strip-and-layout-probe.md) | The readiness strip (T1.4): one page-header row answering "can I train yet", three segments each running the action that already fixes it and each number reused from the panel that owns it (the cache segment and the cache tab are literally the same string); plus `tools/measure_web_layout.py`, the committed headless-Chrome layout probe the previous three rounds kept rewriting and throwing away | Changing the page header or the three-column layout, the readiness strip, the cache panel's status line, the export panel's report, or the layout probe |
| [command-palette](changelog/command-palette.md) | The command palette (T3): Ctrl+K opens a modal list of 23 commands, each one a single call to the very function its own button calls (the "no privileged path" rule, enforced by a criterion), unavailable commands are shown with their reason with the owning control having the last word, and the matcher is local with no dependency. | Changing `palette.js`, the command table in `app.js`, any control id it names, the job shelf's change hook, or the palette steps in the layout probe |
| [test-loop-tiers](changelog/test-loop-tiers.md) | The test loop is two tiers now: `tools/check_relevant.py` runs only the tests and harnesses that name what changed (a frontend change costs ~1.5 s instead of ~80 s), reports anything no test names as UNCOVERED, and `--full` is the whole gate before reporting. | Changing the gates, adding tests, or wondering why a round takes minutes |
| [light-mode](changelog/light-mode.md) | Light mode, and the reason it is a classic script: three `:root`-prefixed token blocks with no colour literal below them (a light theme, the on-image colours that are identical in both themes, and the frozen dark theme), a switch written by one function (shipped at the header row's left end, moved to the row's right end the same day - see [topbar-layout](changelog/topbar-layout.md)), and `js/theme-boot.js` - the only non-module script in the page - applying a stored choice before the first paint because a deferred module runs ~160 ms after it. | Changing the palette, the token blocks, `theme.js`/`theme-boot.js`, the header row's arrangement, or the theme passes and contrast table in `tools/measure_web_layout.py` |

| [topbar-layout](changelog/topbar-layout.md) | Two rows, one grammar: each row says what it is on the left, what state it is in next to it, and its controls at the right end. The browse scope (含子目录) and the refresh action moved to the grid's own toolbar - the scope because it changes what the grid contains (and `api/fs.py:5-12` keeps `dirs` one level deep with non-recursive child counts, the fact that killed the left-column option), the refresh because the listing it re-fetches is the grid's content (icon-only, its words still the accessible name and tooltip, so there is no second refresh button) - so the header keeps identity, state, the two preferences and, last, the command palette's entry; the top-left placement the light-mode round was handed was withdrawn the same day. One decorative `.group-sep` draws the toolbar's scope \| state boundary; the header's was dropped once the action that gave it a second side left. | Changing the page header or the gallery toolbar, where the browse scope, the refresh action, the theme switch or the palette's entry sits, or the `.group-sep` separator |
| [command-bar-and-census-row](changelog/command-bar-and-census-row.md) | The palette's entry became a **command bar** and its panel a **dropdown, not a modal**: no backdrop, no `aria-modal`, Tab closes instead of trapping, Escape and a click outside close, Ctrl+K only opens - and the bar shows the gesture (`palette.openKey`, a key name, untranslated, contained by `palette.openTitle` per WCAG 2.5.3) instead of naming the feature. The census (`#dir-counts`) left the header for a breadcrumb row as a sibling of the nav that is rebuilt on every navigation. Also fixes the `--shot` defect: a shot frame sized from the window and restyled after load let the app boot against a non-final layout, so one PNG read the resizer minimums (200/280) while the JSON measured 260/380. | Changing the command bar or the palette's shell, the header row's arrangement, the census line or the breadcrumb row, or the `--shot`/`--lang` modes of the layout probe |

| [changelog/gallery-scroll-priority](changelog/gallery-scroll-priority.md) | The gallery's thumbnail queue serves the tiles the user has scrolled onto before the prefetches queued for the first screen: the 400px prefetch margin decides *whether* a tile is queued, a second zero-margin observer decides its priority | You want to know why scrolling down showed the wrong images first, or what the gallery's two observers are for |

| [changelog/export-scope-list](changelog/export-scope-list.md) | The scaling export stopped covering the whole folder: `POST /api/scale/run` takes an explicit `images` list - the column's scope strip, snapshotted when Start is pressed - and an empty or absent list is 400 `no_images` rather than "then do the whole directory", so the widened export is unreachable (the panel keeps Start disabled and says why). Every entry is validated (allowlist → file → image extension → under `root`) with the first bad one rejecting the request, duplicates are dropped, and `root` keeps its job as the base the target tree mirrors. The audit the same round ran found the crop panel reading the strip only in `onShow()` (fixed: it subscribes like the tagger and the batch panel) and two stale statements about which panels obey the strip. | Changing the §4.14 request contract, the scale/crop panels' blast radius, or the scope strip's copy; or asking why an export no longer takes a directory to walk |
| [changelog/open-source-readiness](changelog/open-source-readiness.md) | Publishing the repository (2026-09-21): MIT licence, CI on Linux and Windows, community files, **every personal path and private directory name removed** (`local_paths.ini` + the committed sample dataset), the golden counts deleted instead of re-sampled, and the suite learning to skip rather than fail (42 red outcomes measured on a clean checkout, 0 after) | You are wondering why a test skipped on your machine, where the tests get their paths from, what the GitHub Actions jobs run, or where the threat model is written down |
| [changelog/remembered-panel-parameters](changelog/remembered-panel-parameters.md) | The scaling panel's parameters survive a reload: the shared store (`trainparams.js`) reads one localStorage entry (`kdt.trainParams`) when it is built and writes it whenever a setter accepts a value, so the resolution / caption extension / resample / format / quality / optimize / no-upscale and `writeToml` come back on the next visit. The remembered field list is explicit and pinned, because what is **not** in it is the point: the target directory (a location nobody chose this session) and `overwrite_dataset_toml` (a permission for one run, which the run that skips the file reports). A remembered resample/format name is validated against the domain the store now owns, so an entry from an older build falls back to the default instead of reaching a `<select>` with no such option; corrupt or hostile storage reads as "nothing stored" | Changing what the panels remember, the shared store's key or field list, or asking why the target directory / overwrite switch is not remembered |
| [changelog/scope-recursive-cache](changelog/scope-recursive-cache.md) | The scope strip's "directory + subdirectories" listing stopped describing trees that are not on screen: the cache is only an answer for the directory it was loaded from (after navigating it used to hand the previous directory's images to every panel acting on the scope, the two that write included), and `scope.invalidate()` - called by app.js wherever a fresh listing is installed - drops it, so a crop's archive beside its source reaches the count instead of staying invisible until the user navigates away and back. Found by the export-scope-list review, one layer down: there the panel was wrong, here the control was | Changing `scope.js`'s caching, the strip's counts, or what the panels act on after a navigation or a write into the open directory |
